answer: Proof of Stake functions as a Sybil resistance mechanism by tethering identity to capital, ensuring that an attacker cannot sprawl across the digital meadow without significant investment. Like mapping a pigment onto a physical knoll, the protocol anchors each node to verifiable collateral. An attacker must commit substantial tokens to secure influence; thus, creating fake identities becomes economically prohibitive, as the cost of acquiring sufficient stake outweighs potential gains from malicious consensus manipulation.
